_comment: Canonical role-registration expectations. Source of truth for role surface coverage (b80f0bdf). Roles = live tackle.roles; per-role keys override roleDefaults. A surface marked true must exist and verify; false = deliberately absent (do not create). governance = receipt-issuing allowlist (harness-srv KNOWN_EXECUTORS), only for roles that emit receipts. kind = address class per Ruling 13 (de5d538f): every entry under roles is kind=role — the only kind carrying a delivery obligation. Non-role addresses (alias/telemetry) live in config/roles/address-kinds.json and must NOT be added here (roles keys must match tackle.roles exactly). Consumers default kind to 'role' when absent. Add a new role here + emit its artifacts, then run bin/verify-roles.py.
